Next ordered work is #734's evidence-based triage of the original backlog under Phase 3 parent #733.

This is readiness, not completion: #733/#734 and the other Phase 3 tasks remain open. No original-backlog disposition, duplicate closure, PR merge or later gate approval is inferred. Preserve useful history and #734's blocked-regression condition for #602. Phase 3 gate #738 requires its own human decision. Project fields remain unsynchronized after HTTP 403.
